learning_outcomes.text: Acquire knowledge about entrepreneurship theory and the evaluation of business functions for small and medium-sized enterprises.
Be able to form ideas about the process of starting a business/establishing a business, establishing a new business, and acquiring an existing business.
Be able to create a business and marketing plan.
Be able to perform financial planning for entrepreneurs and small businesses.
Acquire knowledge about the entrepreneurial investment model.
Learn the concept of corporate entrepreneur.

syllabus_topics: Entrepreneurship, Concept of Entrepreneurship, Importance and Classification of Entrepreneurship, Problems in Entrepreneurship Research
Entrepreneurship Process and Interaction with the Environment
The Entrepreneur as an Individual and Characteristics
Process of starting a business/establishing a business, establishing a new business, acquiring an existing business
Business model, concept and economic structure of the business model
Business and marketing plan, Financial planning for entrepreneurs and small businesses
Entrepreneurial marketing, innovation, technology and entrepreneurship
bibliography: Tamer Müftüoğlu ve Tülin Durukan, Girişimcilik ve KOBİ’ler, Gazi Kitapevi, Ankara, 2004.
Semra Arıkan, Girişimcilik, Siyasal Kitapevi, Ankara, 2004.
institution: Düzce University — Elektrik-Elektronik Mühendisliği (Electrical-Electronics Engineering), Normal Öğretim
